chapter: One Yet to Take a Bow
act_title: One Yet to Take a Bow

quests.title: One Yet to Take a Bow

dialogue.sit: (The Korolevskiy Theater sure is lively... It's a real bastion of the arts.)

dialogue.t: ...No way! D—Did you say a ghost!?

dialogue.sit: (Hmm? What are they talking about over there?)

dialogue.t: It's true, I swear! Everyone's talking about it. The moment it strikes midnight, eerie music echoes from the theater. Someone even saw the ghost's shadow dancing on the wall!

dialogue.sit: (A ghost? In the theater?)
(A ghost? But hasn't the Ley Line Disorder here already been resolved?)

dialogue.t: Y—You're sure someone didn't just make that up to scare people?
Yes! I heard it last night! The sound was so eerie, I don't even know how to describe it...

dialogue.sit: (Curious... I'll come back and take a look in the early hours.)
(I have to say, with all the lights extinguished, the theater really does feel quite eerie... Is it because it's so empty?)
...! What was that?
(It was just the wind... Did someone leave a window open?)
(Is that really the sound of a piano? Why does it sound so unsettling...?)

dialogue.t: ...Who's there?

dialogue.sit: (A voice? Where is it coming from!?)

dialogue.t: ...{NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: O—Odette?

dialogue.t: Yes.
What were you expecting? A ghost?

dialogue.sit: ...So you heard about the rumors.

dialogue.t: I have — the eerie music and the dancing ghost.
Here. This is the true form of said "ghost."

dialogue.sit: (What is that? An ornament? A decoration?)

dialogue.t: It's a music box. It was a birthday gift from my mother when I was little.
It used to play beautiful melodies, but its internal mechanisms have deteriorated over time, and now...
It sounds terrible, doesn't it?
It'll take some time to fix. But... my daytime schedule tends to be quite packed, and I don't have the right tools at home, so I had to sneak off to my private lounge in the middle of the night...

dialogue.sit: (Wait, did she sneak in through that window that was left open...)
Did you just say...
Your private lounge room?

dialogue.t: Yes, this area belongs to me. Doesn't it look the part?

dialogue.sit: (It's emptier than I imagined... It seems she really does put all her energy into dancing...)
Sorry...
I shouldn't have barged in...

dialogue.t: It's fine. To be quite honest, neither of us should be here at this time.
But I must say, you're pretty brave. Most would've fled the moment they heard the music or saw a "ghost."

dialogue.sit: So, about your music box...
What can I do to help?

dialogue.t: ..."Always eager to help." That's what they say about you. I guess they were right.
I appreciate the offer, but I want to fix it myself.
...But if you could help me collect some relevant materials and keep it a secret for me, I'd really appreciate that.

dialogue.sit: Consider it done.

dialogue.t: Also... It seems the decor in my lounge doesn't match your expectations. If you want to redecorate it to your liking, you're most welcome.
Think of it as a reward for keeping my secret?

dialogue.sit: (...A reward?)

dialogue.t: Did you not want one? Vodyanitsa said fans would do anything for a peek behind the scenes.
Oh, that said, could you hold off until the music box is fixed? Your redecoration project, I mean.

dialogue.sit: ...Why?

dialogue.t: It scares people away. Makes it much more peaceful around here.

dialogue.sit: After that, Odette spends quite some time bringing the music box (mostly) back to working order...

quests.description: You hear rumors that eerie music sometimes echoes from the Korolevskiy Theater around midnight, and that people have even seen shadows dancing on the walls…
